description:
Let your Music City adventure begin! This stylish suite is just steps from Broadway, putting you in the heart of the action. Enjoy live music, explore the vibrant nightlife, then return to your comfortable and stylish retreat.

The space
Nashville's Heartbeat: Your Music City Getaway

Prime Location:
- Walkable to Broadway! Immerse yourself in the legendary bars, honky tonks, and live music venues just steps from your door.
-Driving to Nashville? One FREE reserved parking in our garage! We got you covered.
- Discover Nashville’s iconic landmarks: Explore the Ryman, Country Music Hall of Fame, and Johnny Cash Museum – all within easy walking distance.
- Conveniently located near the Music City Center, Bridgestone Arena, Nissan Stadium, The Gulch, Music Row, and more.

Modern suite, Unforgettable Stay:
This stylish and versatile space is perfect for groups. Relax on the plush king bed or the comfy king sofa bed (or convert it to two cozy twin sleepers).

Your Home Away From Home:
- Enjoy a fully equipped kitchen, in-unit washer/dryer, and high-speed Wi-Fi.
- Unwind with a 65-inch 4K UHD Smart TV in the living room and a 50-inch UHD Smart TV in the bedroom.
- The spacious dining area is perfect for game nights or enjoying meals together.

Music City Vibes: Spin some tunes on the in-suite record player featuring a selection of records from local artists and top country & blues musicians.

Indulge & Relax:
- Enjoy premium body care products, a luxurious rain shower, and complimentary coffee and snacks.
- Take in the vibrant energy of downtown Nashville with stunning skyline views from most parts of the suite.

Book your Nashville adventure today and experience the magic of Music City!

Guest access
Resort-Style Relaxation Awaits:
Relax and rejuvenate with resort-style amenities. Enjoy a refreshing dip in the pool, stay active in the state-of-the-art gym, or gather around the captivating rooftop firepits. 

Enjoy an elevated lifestyle with a host of amenities:
Secure building access
Garage parking (FREE PARKING)

Co-working spaces
Entertainment lounge
Grilling stations (first-come, first-served)
Rooftop fire pits
Inviting indoor fireplace
Game room with pool table
Gathering and networking spaces
Indoor and outdoor entertaining areas
Sun deck
Complimentary coffee station
Wi-Fi in common areas
24-hour on-site building management

Addition details:
Self check-in allows for flexible arrival times: Your key fobs will be waiting for you at the Keycafe kiosk located in the lobby. Further details will be provided upon booking.

Parking Information: For your convenience, we offer complimentary reserved parking. Your designated parking space details will be included in your check-in instructions before arrival. Please note that parking is managed and strictly monitored by the parking authorities.
